items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: The colour, radius, spacing, type, shadow, motion and layout tokens every item renders with, and the Mona Sans font.
items.docs: Adds the light and dark colour variables, the radius, spacing and type scales, the popover shadow, the motion, z-index and container tokens, and the Mona Sans font to your CSS file. Every item in this registry depends on it. The colour variables use the shadcn/ui names. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/theme

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Joins and merges class names, and resolves the token utilities so a className override replaces them.
items.docs: Import cn from @/lib/cn and pass it class names; a later class replaces an earlier one in the same group, token utilities such as text-micro, shadow-popover and duration-quick included. Every component item in this registry imports it. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/theme

items.name: record-list
items.title: Record list
items.description: A list of record rows with one tab stop, arrow-key focus, keyboard peek and keyboard selection.
items.docs: RecordList holds RecordRow children; installing record-list installs record-row. The list is one tab stop. ↑ ↓ Home End move focus, Space toggles peek on the focused row (an open peek follows focus), X toggles selection on a row that has a RecordRowSelect, Esc closes peek and then clears the selection. RecordList renders no peek: read peekValue with onPeekValueChange and render a read-only preview of the item's page beside the list or in a drawer at wide widths, and under the row or in a bottom drawer at narrow ones; it holds nothing that page lacks. Show the key hints in text near the list and point aria-describedby at them. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: record-row
items.title: Record row
items.description: A 44px row whose parts are named for the rank of what they hold, so any data lines up, reads and narrows by rank.
items.docs: Rank each value, then compose: an optional RecordRowSelect (a row without one cannot be selected), then RecordRowLink holding RecordRowIdentify (rank 1: an optional RecordRowKey, an optional RecordRowGlyph such as a status-mark drawn as its dot only, then RecordRowName, then an optional one-line RecordRowDescription) and one RecordRowRead per rank 2 reading, at most eight, then an optional RecordRowPeek, a button that toggles peek on the row so a click on RecordRowLink can open the item's page. Hold a person-mark, figure, track, relative-time, status-mark or field-state in each Read. Rank 4 is a field-card on a rank 1 or 2 value; rank 5 is the item's page, reached through RecordRowLink's render, and peek, rendered from RecordList's peekValue, previews part of it read-only. Columns line up down the list. When the list narrows the description truncates, then the name; below 640px the description is hidden; set narrow="abbreviate" to switch a part to its short form below 768px, or narrow="hide" to drop it below 640px, and keep a hidden value in peek and on the item's page. While loading, render RecordRowLoading with the same parts. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: status-mark
items.title: Status mark
items.description: A state drawn as a shape-coded dot and its word, for a rank 2 Read.
items.docs: Compose StatusMarkDot (fill none, half or full) then StatusMarkLabel. The dot tells states apart by shape, not colour. In a RecordRowGlyph, and in an abbreviated RecordRowRead, only the dot is drawn and the word is read by screen readers. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: person-mark
items.title: Person mark
items.description: A person's initials in a 24px circle, then their name.
items.docs: Pass name; the initials come from its first and last words. In an abbreviated RecordRowRead only the initials are drawn and the name is read by screen readers. Wrap it in a field-card to show more about the person. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: A number the caller compares down a list, in tabular figures, with a compact short form.
items.docs: Pass value and Intl.NumberFormat options in format, and a locale so server and browser render the same text. It sits at the end of its column. In an abbreviated RecordRowRead it switches to compact notation, such as $13K. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: track
items.title: Track
items.description: A measurement within a known range, drawn as a bar and its value, on Base UI Meter.
items.docs: Pass value, min and max, a format and an aria-label. In an abbreviated RecordRowRead the bar is dropped and the value stays. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative time
items.description: A moment stated relative to now, with a narrow short form.
items.docs: Pass dateTime and now as ISO 8601 strings; passing now keeps server and browser output the same. In an abbreviated RecordRowRead it switches to the narrow form, such as 2h ago. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: field-state
items.title: Field state
items.description: Stands in for a value that failed to load or that the viewer's role cannot see.
items.docs: Pass state unavailable or hidden. State why, and how to get access, once outside the fields it replaces, such as in the list footer. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list

items.name: field-card
items.title: Field card
items.description: Rank 4: a hover card on a rank 1 or 2 value with more about that entity or property.
items.docs: Compose FieldCard, FieldCardTrigger around the value, then FieldCardContent. It opens 300ms after the pointer enters and closes when it leaves; the trigger is not focusable, so every field in the card must also appear in peek and on the item's page. It may hold links. The card renders into the body; pass FieldCardContent a container to render it inside a scaled or panned surface instead. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/record-list
